entities.name: Imperial Shrine
entities.description: Place where the highest-ranking officers of the Madaran Empire had audiences with Nicol Bolas, located amid three strong mana lines; destroyed by Tetsuo's Meteor Hammer.

entities.name: Madaran Empire
entities.description: Empire whose officers met Nicol Bolas at the Imperial Shrine.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon and emperor who partially manifested in the shrine due to his need for mana.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: Imperial regent who stayed in the Shrine and lost his final battle there to Tetsuo Umezawa.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Defeated Ramses Overdark in the Shrine and destroyed it with a Meteor Hammer spell.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: War during which Ramses Overdark was promoted to imperial regent.

entities.name: Suido River
entities.description: Source of blue mana line near the shrine.

entities.name: Gitte-Yatay Mountains
entities.description: Source of red mana line near the shrine.

events.summary: Ramses Overdark fought and lost his final battle against Tetsuo Umezawa in the Imperial Shrine.
events.quote: it was there that he fought, and lost, his final battle against Tetsuo Umezawa

events.summary: The Shrine was destroyed by Tetsuo's Meteor Hammer spell.
events.quote: The Shrine was destroyed shortly after that by Tetsuo’s Meteor Hammer spell.

relations.quote: his final battle against Tetsuo Umezawa

relations.note: Ramses served the emperor as imperial regent.
relations.quote: After being promoted to imperial regent during the Madara-Edemi War
